name: 辛美尔
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_七_号角的年月.md:1672
who: Himmel, the hero of the last years of the war, a young man who looks about twenty-two, boyishly handsome and glad to be a hero: about 172 cm, short for a hero and a full head shorter than the priest Heiter, slim and light-framed with neat narrow shoulders. Soft sky-blue hair cut short and a little tousled, with one lock falling over the forehead that he brushes aside with a finger before he speaks; a delicate, refined, fine-boned face exactly like the reference pictures: a slim jaw, a small fine nose, large clear pale-blue eyes with soft lashes, fine light brows and a gentle mouth, pretty rather than rugged, the eyes crinkling first when he smiles, a small beauty mark under the outer corner of his left eye (on the viewer's right when he faces us). A warm, joking, easy air, and underneath it a tireless carefulness: he counts the people in a room before he sits. The left sleeve is always buttoned to the wrist, a faint white glow showing under the cuff.
build: He is short and slight: about 172 cm, about 6.8 heads tall, a slim, light, boyish frame with neat narrow shoulders, NOT broad, NOT heavy, NOT tall; trained and quick rather than strong.
palette: sky blue and cream white, royal blue cloth with white frog buttons, a little gold, a pale blue blade
casual: His hero's travelling clothes, exactly as in the reference picture: a long cream-white cloak to the ankles with a high folded collar fastened at the throat, over a fitted royal-blue tunic closed down the front with a row of white frog buttons, white bands at the collar and cuffs, white trousers and dark knee boots; a plain broad straight sword with a gold crossguard set with one blue gem and a blue-wrapped grip, its lacquer worn, held point-down before him with both hands folded on the pommel. A warm, easy, boyish smile.
private: Sitting on a wall at night: the cloak off and folded under him, the blue tunic open at the collar over a pale linen shirt, the right sleeve rolled and the left sleeve kept buttoned, the sword laid across his knees; a tired, gentle smile.
battle: A hard night on the wall: the cream cloak thrown back over the shoulders, light silver pauldrons and a silver breast-piece over the blue tunic, leather bracers, the left sleeve buttoned tight over the faintly glowing arm. He holds the broad sword upright in his right hand before him, the blade lit by a pale blue glow, and glances back over his shoulder counting heads; a calm, bright, determined stance.
formal: Asked to an audience in a wall-city: the cream cloak clean and brushed, the blue tunic pressed and buttoned to the collar, the sword at his side in a polished scabbard, the hair tidied with the one lock left falling. He strikes a deliberately heroic pose with one hand on the hilt and a sheepish, boyish half-smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale-blue eyes looking at the viewer with a warm, crinkling, boyish smile, a finger brushing the lock of hair on his forehead. Cool blue night light from one side with a faint white glow rising from his left sleeve. Foreground blur: the gold crossguard of a worn sword and drifting night-wall dust. He wears the cream cloak over the royal-blue tunic with its white frog buttons.

name: 康拉德
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_七_号角的年月.md:241
who: Konrad, a human clerk of the White Deer Library, copyist at the Red Tablet tier, thirty-four: about 172 cm, thin with a slight stoop from years bent over the copying desk. Short-cropped black hair with one lock turned white at his left temple (on the viewer's right when they face us), an ink smudge on his forehead that never quite washes off, pale violet eyes that narrow when he reads and narrow the same way when he looks at a person. A thick callus on the middle finger of his right hand from the pen. Quiet, exact, patient, a man who reads people line by line.
build: 172 cm, thin and a little stooped: narrow shoulders, long fingers, a lean frame that sits for hours without moving.
palette: ash grey wool, ink black, pale violet, copper
casual: His clerk's clothes: a grey wool library robe that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, black cloth sleeve-covers over the cuffs so the ink does not rub off, a copper ink-pot hung at his belt, dark trousers, plain boots; a small hand-copied booklet held against his chest in his left hand. His eyes are narrowed in a patient, reading look.
private: Late at the copying desk in his lodging: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, a knitted grey waistcoat, soft slippers, the library robe hung on a peg, the ink-pot on the desk. He holds a quill and rubs the ink mark on his forehead with the back of a finger. A tired, mild look.
battle: A scribe on the wall in wartime: the grey library robe belted with the black sleeve-covers on, bare headed, a satchel of ledgers slung across the chest, the copper ink-pot at his belt with a thin glowing line of ink on its rim. He stands with a ledger open on his left forearm and a quill in his right hand, writing a list of names; he does not fight. A calm, intent look.
battle_pose: 3) the working outfit: crouched on one knee with a ledger open on the other, the quill moving in his right hand, the narrowed violet eyes fixed on the page, ink-pot at the belt; he does not fight.
formal: At a naming reading in the library: a clean dark-grey library robe closing with a few buttons at the front, black cloth sleeve-covers left on, a white collar, a copper ink-pot at the belt, a small silver stylus brooch of the Red Tablet tier, the hair combed flat, the little booklet held in both hands, its pages faintly lit where the names are written. He stands upright, a grave, careful look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the pale violet eyes narrowed at the viewer as if reading a line, the ink smudge on the forehead and the white lock at the temple clear. Warm candle light from one side, cool grey stone light from the other. Foreground blur: the edge of a ledger page and a quill tip. He wears the grey library robe.

name: 珊瑟
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_七_号角的年月.md:459
who: Shanse, a human girl of fifteen from a yak-herding family by the Windbell Gorge suspension bridge, a herder who will one day be a bowwoman: about 163 cm, slight and long-legged, wholly covered by her clothes. Fair skin with two patches of red on her cheeks from the highland wind. Very long wheat-coloured hair, left unbound and always streaming in the wind however she tries to hold it with a leather cord. Honey-coloured eyes that narrow when she looks far away. A bright, restless, outdoorsy air.
palette: wheat gold and honey, yak-wool brown and cream, wind-red, birch pale wood
casual: Her herding clothes: a knee-length yak-wool tunic with long sleeves worn smooth and shiny at the cuffs, over thick wool leggings and sturdy laced boots, a leather cord loosely holding back a little of her hair, a cattle-horn whistle hung at her belt, a small birch bow with a string twisted from yak-tail hair slung on her back. She stands with her weight on one leg, looking into the distance with narrowed eyes.
private: Home by the stove after the herd is in: a plain long-sleeved undyed wool dress to the ankle, a knitted shawl, thick socks, the hair loose and drifting even indoors. She holds a bowl of warm milk in both hands. A tired, easy look.
battle: Out on the high pasture with a bad wind coming: the yak-wool tunic belted tight over leggings, a short hooded cloak, leather bracers over the long sleeves. She holds the small birch bow low in her left hand and an arrow in her right, the hair streaming sideways; a steady, intent look.
formal: At a highland feast day: her best long-sleeved dress of dyed blue wool with a high round neck and a plain white collar, a woven belt, the horn whistle on a ribbon, the hair loose with a single braid in front. She stands with hands folded, a shy, clear-eyed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait to the shoulders, the wheat-coloured hair streaming across the frame, the honey eyes wide open and looking straight at the viewer with a sincere, determined look, mouth closed. Cold bright highland light from one side, a warm lantern gold from the other. Foreground blur: a few strands of flying hair and the tip of a cattle-horn whistle. She wears the yak-wool tunic.

name: 梅洛萨
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_七_号角的年月.md:515
who: Melosa, a siren of the sea-folk and a singer of the Tidesong kingdom who keeps one island's sea-lanes, sixty-one and looking in her early thirties: about 174 cm, tall and slender. Skin of a faint sea-teal, along each side of her neck a row of fine silver markings that glow when she sings. Long deep-blue hair that looks like waterweed when wet. Silver-grey eyes that brighten when she looks at water. Her voice is hoarse now, little more than breath, but when she sings the markings still light. A calm, gentle, stubborn air. Her skin has a faint but visible cool sea-teal cast all over, not plain warm human pink.
build: 174 cm, tall and slender: long straight shoulders, strong lungs, a modest bust, a narrow waist and long legs built for deep diving.
palette: sea teal and deep blue, silver, shell white, pale sea green
casual: Her singer's clothes: a long sea-green robe of the Tidesong singers that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves with a row of small shells hanging from each cuff that click when she walks, a cord of braided seaweed round her neck with a white conch shell on it, bare feet. With one hand she lifts that same conch, still hanging on its neck cord, loosely against her collarbone, a calm, listening look; there is only ONE conch in the picture, the seaweed cord is worn round the neck and nothing hangs from her waist.
private: Resting on the quay at night: a loose pale sea-blue linen dress with long sleeves, a knitted grey shawl, the robe folded beside her, the conch on its cord. Her hand rests on the boat rail. A tired, mild look.
battle: Singing the last song above the sunken sea: the sea-green robe belted tight, a short oilcloth cape thrown back, the shell cuffs, bare feet braced on a ship's bow. She stands upright with the white conch raised at her lips in her right hand, the silver markings on her neck blazing, the wind pulling her blue hair back; a resolute stare.
formal: At a leave-taking of the fleet: a dark-teal Tidesong singer's long overrobe open over a sea-green under-dress, silver thread along the hems, the row of small shells at each cuff, a sash of braided seaweed at the waist, the white conch on its cord, the hair braided and pinned with a pearl comb. She stands very straight with the hands folded, a faint ripple of water moving through the silver thread, a grave, tender look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face lifted a little, the silver-grey eyes looking at the viewer, mouth closed, a quiet look. The silver markings on the neck glowing softly. Cool blue-green sea light from one side, a warm lantern gold from the other. Foreground blur: sea spray and the white conch. She wears the sea-green robe.

name: 芮娅
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_七_号角的年月.md:674
who: Ria, a sea-demon of the Deep Tide, a nineteen-year-old apprentice tide-reader of the old shoals on the north shore of the Salt Sea, and she looks exactly nineteen: about 162 cm, lean, strong and long-bodied from swimming. A layer of fine silver-blue scales along the sides of her neck and on her forearms; three gill slits behind each ear that open in water and close on land into three fine lines; a thin web between her fingers that shows the light. Chin-length deep-teal hair, always damp. Large deep-sea dark green eyes that catch the light at night and underwater. A quiet, watchful, steady air.
build: 162 cm, lean and wiry: thin strong shoulders and back, a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: deep teal and sea green, silver-blue scale shimmer, salt white, wet grey
casual: Her tide family's clothes: a short-sleeved tunic with a button front and long trousers woven from seaweed fibre that stay light when wet, bare feet or sandals, a short measuring rod marked with tide levels hung at her belt, a woven pouch of salt clay. She stands at the water's edge, her head tilted, watching the waves without blinking.
private: At home on the shoal at dusk: a loose seaweed-linen shirt with long sleeves rolled, soft wide trousers, the damp hair pushed behind her ears, the measuring rod leaning beside her. She holds a clay cup of warm brine tea. A tired, mild look.
battle: On the shoal as the tide turns against an attack: the woven tunic and trousers belted tight, leather wrist guards over her scaled forearms, a short salt-stone knife at the hip, a rolled tide-chart across her back. She grips the measuring rod in her right hand like a short staff, knees bent, the water around her feet rippling; a focused stare.
formal: At a tide-reader's rite at the old shoals: a clean sea-green woven tunic with a loose open collar and a salt-stone pendant, long seaweed-fibre trousers, a short sash holding the tide rod, the tide-chart scroll held in both hands with its edge glowing silver-blue, a shell comb in her damp hair, bare feet. She stands very straight, a serious, calm look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the dark green eyes reflecting a bright rim of light, looking straight at the viewer without blinking, mouth closed. The silver-blue scales on her neck shimmer and the three gill lines behind one ear are visible. Cold blue light from the water on one side, a warm lantern gold on the other. Foreground blur: drops of water and the end of a tide-measuring rod. She wears the seaweed-fibre tunic.

name: 欧丝嘉
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_七_号角的年月.md:730
who: Osca, a human bowwoman of the southernmost wall-tower of the Long Rampart, twenty-two and looking twenty-two: about 170 cm, medium-tall with broad shoulders, the right shoulder a little higher than the left from drawing the bow. Weather-reddened cheeks, an old scar across the bridge of her nose. Orange-red hair in one short braid tucked up into her helmet. Pale gold eyes that narrow when she looks at something far off. Her right arm is thicker than her left. A blunt, steady, dry air.
build: 170 cm, broad-shouldered and straight-backed: a thick right arm, a full C-cup, a firm waist and strong rounded hips.
palette: orange red and pale gold, worn leather brown, wall-stone grey, polished steel
casual: Her wall bowwoman's gear: a worn brown leather jerkin with sleeves, a polished leather pad on her right shoulder (on the viewer's left when they face us), dark trousers, boots, an open-faced iron helmet with the braid tucked under; a long bow with the grip wrapped in layer upon layer of leather strips slung across her back and an old quiver with a white-worn mouth at her hip. She squints at something far off.
private: Off watch in the tower room: a plain undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, loose dark trousers, soft boots, the braid let down over one shoulder, the bow hung on its peg. She oils the bowstring with a rag, a dry, tired look.
battle: Drawing from the battlement in the dark: the brown leather jerkin laced tight over a dark-green quilted undercoat, the right shoulder pad, bracers with a few dimmed rune lines, the open-faced iron helmet on. She draws the long bow to full, an arrow nocked and the string at her cheek, left foot forward behind the crenel, the tower wall at her back; a hard narrowed stare along the arrow.
formal: On the wall for a muster: her cleaned leather jerkin over a grey wool tunic, a short dark-green cloak, the helmet under her arm, the bow unstrung in her left hand, the braid neatly coiled. She stands straight, a proud, dry look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait with the face half turned, the pale gold eyes narrowed at the viewer as if sighting down an arrow, a firm closed mouth, the scar on the bridge of the nose clear. Cold bluish wall-top light from one side, a warm torch gold from the other. Foreground blur: a leather-wrapped bow limb and a feather fletching. She wears the leather jerkin with the shoulder pad.

name: 伯恩特
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_七_号角的年月.md:786
who: Bernt, a human horn-blower of the southernmost wall-tower of the Long Rampart, fifty: about 168 cm, short and thick-set, the left shoulder sagging lower than the right so that he walks leaning a little to the right (the sagging shoulder is on the viewer's right when they face us). A face carved with wind lines, short grey-white beard, a thick ring of callus on his lips from the horn, faded blue eyes whose corners droop so that he always looks sleepy though he wakes faster than anyone at night. A dry, quiet, watchful air. The soft replaced leather patch on the jerkin is on his LEFT shoulder, the sagging one (on the viewer's right when he faces us), and never on the right shoulder, in every panel where the jerkin shows.
build: 168 cm, short and thick: a barrel chest, a heavy neck, a sagging left shoulder and strong forearms.
palette: faded blue and grey-white, old leather brown, polished brass, wall-stone grey
casual: His old wall hand's clothes: a worn brown leather jerkin with the left shoulder patch replaced with soft leather, a thick wool shirt under it, dark trousers, boots, a polished brass horn mouthpiece hung at his belt on a cord. He stands with both hands hanging, the eyes drooping in a sleepy, watchful look.
private: In the tower room at the end of the night: the jerkin off, a loose wool shirt with the sleeves rolled and the collar open, soft felt shoes, the brass mouthpiece laid on the table beside a cup of thin soup. A weary, mild look.
battle: Blowing the call on the wall: the old leather jerkin laced tight with an oilcloth cape, the soft left-shoulder patch, an iron cap, bracers with a small brass wall-horn badge. He holds a long brass horn raised at his lips in both hands, the bell pointing up and out over the battlement, the sagging shoulder braced against the stone; a sharp, wide-awake stare. The soft leather patch is on the left shoulder, on the viewer's right when he faces us, the same side as in the first panel.
formal: At the muster of the tower garrison: a clean grey wool coat buttoned to the neck over the jerkin, the brass mouthpiece polished on its cord, the cap under his arm, the beard trimmed. He stands as straight as the shoulder lets him, a grave, tired look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the head slightly tilted, the faded blue drooping eyes looking at the viewer with a dry, sleepy look that is not sleepy at all, the wind-carved lines on the face clear. Cold night light from one side, a warm lantern gold from the other. Foreground blur: the bell of a brass horn and a glint of its mouthpiece. He wears the old leather jerkin.

name: 艾冯
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_七_号角的年月.md:405
who: Eisen, a dwarf axeman of the Deepwell clan, one hundred and thirty-nine and looking about fifty-five, a legend, before his hair and beard turned white: about 136 cm, short, enormously broad, his shoulders wider across than a doorway. He never takes off his old iron helmet with two curved horns and a nose guard pulled down to the brows; long brown hair spills out under it past his chest, thick long bushy brown brows over small deep-set eyes, a big brown beard braided in two plaits bound with iron rings and hanging to his waist. Flat knuckles on both hands from cutting stone. A short-spoken, immovable, honest air.
build: Short and enormously broad: a barrel chest, a thick neck and heavy forearms.
palette: old iron grey and chestnut brown, washed-out red, dull brass, soot
casual: His everyday gear: the old horned iron helmet, an old Deepwell chain shirt with a pair of iron pauldrons, a red cloak washed out to a faded red hanging from his shoulders, a thick belt, iron-capped boots; a single-edged Deepwell axe with its back hammered flat on one side held at his side, its face unmarked, and a small brass lamp lit at his belt even in daylight. He stands square, a stern, appraising look.
private: Sitting at the door of his house: the helmet still on, but the chain shirt and pauldrons off, a heavy undyed wool tunic with the sleeves rolled, the faded red cloak across his knees, the little lamp burning beside him. He holds a clay mug in a big flat-knuckled hand, a quiet look.
battle: Holding the ground: the horned helmet, the chain shirt and pauldrons buckled tight, the faded red cloak thrown over one shoulder. He grips the axe in both hands across his body, the feet planted wide, the brown beard braids hanging over the mail; an immovable, level stare.
formal: At the Deepwell hearth-hall: a long dark-grey wool coat with iron buttons over the mail, the horned helmet polished but still on, the red cloak brushed, the beard braids freshly bound with new iron rings, the axe left leaning at his side. He stands very straight with the hands at his sides, a grave look.
art: A low-angle broad bust, the head slightly lowered under the horned helmet, the small deep-set eyes looking from under the brown brows at the viewer, a stern but honest look, one flat-knuckled hand holding up a small burning brass lamp. Warm firelight from below on one side. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and the flat back of an axe. He wears the horned helmet and the faded red cloak.

name: 薇儿丹蒂·岚身
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_七_号角的年月.md:1907
who: Verdandi Ransin, a human ranger and the first queen of the Windbell highlands, a legend who looks thirty-nine and has looked it since 10901: about 175 cm, tall and lean, her shoulders and back like a drawn bow. A fair face with two patches of wind-red on the cheekbones. Sky-teal hair in one thick braid that always blows to one side because a wind follows her everywhere. Highland-sky blue eyes that narrow when she looks into the distance. A restless, proud, free air; the wind never stops around her.
build: 175 cm, tall and lean: strong straight shoulders and back, a modest bust, a narrow waist and long legs.
palette: sky teal and highland blue, weathered leather brown, patched grey-green, steel
casual: Her ranger's old gear: a worn leather jerkin with sleeves, a plain half-plate cuirass of dull steel over it with one pauldron, a long cloak that has been torn and mended again and again so that it is a patchwork of grey and green, dark trousers, tall boots; at her belt a long, very thin blade in a scabbard that has been replaced many times and does not match the blade. She stands with the cloak blowing to one side, narrowing her eyes at a far horizon.
private: At a highland hearth in the evening: a plain long-sleeved linen shirt with the collar open, a soft knitted grey cardigan, dark trousers, the cuirass and cloak hung on a post, the thin blade leaning beside her. She holds a cup of warm tea, the braid lifting in a draught. A tired, easy look.
battle: Holding a bridge against a tide: the cuirass buckled over the jerkin, the patched cloak whipped sideways by the wind, bracers, boots planted. She holds the long thin blade low in her right hand, the edge turned out, a gust spiralling visibly around it, the sky-teal braid streaming; a fierce, steady stare.
formal: At a highland council: the old leather jerkin cleaned over a fitted dark-blue wool tunic, the plain half-plate cuirass polished with one pauldron, the mended grey-and-green patchwork cloak brushed and pinned at one shoulder, a sky-teal ribbon tied on the pauldron, the braid wound and pinned up, the thin blade sheathed at her side with a faint breeze stirring the cloak. She stands tall with one hand on the hilt, a calm, commanding look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait with the braid blowing across the frame, the highland-blue eyes narrowed toward the viewer, a firm closed mouth, a faint sense of wind in the loose strands. Cold bright sky light from one side, a warm low sun on the other. Foreground blur: a flying strand of hair and a mended edge of cloak. She wears the patched cloak over the jerkin.

name: 雅克
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_七_号角的年月.md:1962
who: Yak, a human charcoal-burner and a legend sung as Eleven Li, who looks thirty-seven and has looked it since 10942: about 176 cm, broad and solid, covered in charcoal black that never washes out. A charcoal-burner's hands with the black ground into the fingernails. Head shaved close, a face carved with lines of ash and wind, fair skin under the soot, tawny amber eyes. A heavy, stubborn, unaligned air; from far off he looks like a burnt tree stump, and when he comes closer the stump stands up.
build: 176 cm, broad and solid: a thick chest and shoulders, heavy forearms, a firm stance.
palette: soot black and ash grey, patched cloth brown, sheepskin cream, mountain-bronze gold
casual: His charcoal-burner's clothes: a coarse patched cloth tunic with sleeves, thick trousers, wrapped shins, heavy boots, a sheepskin wrapped around the shoulders against the cold; a thick-backed long blade of mountain bronze with a deep notch in the edge, the notch packed with earth pressed hard as stone, held low in his right hand with the point to the ground. He stands like a stump, a heavy, patient look.
private: Sitting by a charcoal kiln at night: the sheepskin off, the tunic sleeves rolled, a battered clay mug in his black hands, the blade laid across his knees. A tired, quiet look.
battle: Holding a line between two armies: the patched tunic belted, bracers of rough leather, the sheepskin thrown back. He grips the notched bronze blade in both hands across his body at waist height, the feet planted wide on blackened ground; an unmoving, level stare.
formal: A rare invitation to a meeting of the two sides: a clean coarse dark cloth tunic belted at the waist over wrapped shins, washed hands still black at the nails, a bundle of charcoal sticks tied at the belt, the sheepskin left at the door, the notched bronze blade sheathed at his side with a faint ember glow in the notch. He stands with hands at his sides, an awkward, solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the shaved head slightly lowered, the tawny amber eyes looking at the viewer with a heavy, patient look, soot lines on the face clear. Warm ember light from one side, cold grey ash light from the other. Foreground blur: drifting ash and the notched edge of a bronze blade. He wears the patched tunic with the sheepskin on his shoulders.
